extraction_notes: Target identity retained exactly from job metadata: AON7544, Alpha Omega Semicon, n-channel MOSFET.
The datasheet title is AON7544 30V N-Channel AlphaMOS and the document revision is Rev 0: April 2012. The supplied PDF contains six pages.

RDS(ON) table rows are transcribed as inclusive maximum values: 5 mOhm at VGS = 10 V and ID = 20 A at TJ = 25 degC, 6.8 mOhm at VGS = 10 V and ID = 20 A at TJ = 125 degC, and 8.5 mOhm at VGS = 4.5 V and ID = 20 A at TJ = 25 degC. The corresponding typical values are 4.1 mOhm, 5.6 mOhm, and 6.7 mOhm.
The gate-threshold table publishes 1.2 V minimum, 1.8 V typical, and 2.2 V maximum at VDS = VGS and ID = 250 uA.
The capacitance table publishes Ciss = 951 pF, Coss = 373 pF, and Crss = 62 pF at VGS = 0 V, VDS = 15 V, and f = 1 MHz. Values are converted to farads.

The typical figures on p. 3 and p. 4 were read directly at visible axis/grid coordinates and rounded to compact values. No points were generated by interpolation. Static curves are marked Note E: pulse width less than 300 us and duty cycle 0.5% maximum.

The transfer curve uses the 25 degC trace from Fig. 2 at VDS = 5 V. The body-diode curve uses the 25 degC trace from Fig. 6 and retains a logarithmic IS axis. Capacitance curves use Fig. 8 with VGS = 0 V and f = 1 MHz; the figure does not state a temperature.
